description: Deletes one contact, named by id. Without purge the contact is soft-deleted and drops out of lists and chats. With purge true the contact and what Cosend holds about them are erased for good (an owner’s action, for a data-protection request). Nothing is sent to the contact. It deletes only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it deletes nothing and returns a preview naming the contact and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

purge.description: true to erase the contact for good, as a data-protection erasure does; omit to delete it so it can be recovered. Owners only.

name: delete_contact
title: Delete a contact
